items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: he has taken some of the members from the Alex Welsh's Band and the Alex Welsh Band is still going

ctx.x: Yeah - for instance, there's Humphrey Littleton's Band now; he has taken some of the members from the Alex Welsh's Band and the Alex Welsh Band is still going; he has taken some of the members of his first

band back. So, those are the two-- when it comes to just traditional and swing-- jazz bands, they are the two top names in Britian; now, there are some other bands there that tour Germany almost constantly. I can't just think of their names off-hand, but they're world famous. One, Midnight Moscow Band - they did that famous record--
